question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 4% per month for 7 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of Simple Interest = Rate per period × Number of periods.

Effective Rate = 4% × 7 = 28%

Simple Interest = 28% of Principal

I = (28 ÷ 100) × 1200 = 336

**∴ The correct answer is ₹336.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 Principal
 ₹1200
 
 
 
• 
 Time: 7 months
 Rate: 4% / month

 
 
 Total SI
 ₹336

 
 SI = ₹1200 × 28% = ₹336

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per month

Time (T) = 7 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Both rate and time are given in months, so no unit conversion is necessary.

⇒ SI = (1200 × 4 × 7) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × (4 × 7)

⇒ SI = 12 × 28

⇒ SI = 336

**∴ The correct answer is ₹336.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Interest Rate in SI

In simple interest, the overall percentage of interest is simply the product of Rate per period and Total periods. Example: 4% per month for 7 months = 28% total interest.

Unit Consistency of Rate and Time

Always ensure the time unit matches the rate unit before using the SI formula. If the rate is per annum and time is in months, time must be converted to years by dividing by 12.

Compound Interest (CI)

If the interest was compounded monthly, the Amount formula A = P(1 + R÷100)T would be used, and Compound Interest would be calculated as CI = A − P.
